_comment: Mission-console-only hooks, attached at launch via `claude --settings`. Loaded ADDITIVELY (it merges with normal user/project settings, it does not replace them). Wired by console-session.sh (ops), console-session-wt.sh -> claude-miss (dev), and scripts/claude-miss-integrator (integrator, when given its mission name), so it never affects the operator's own Claude sessions. Driven by $MISSION_* abs paths the launch scripts export. Bark pushes: Notification + Stop also run $MISSION_NOTIFY (scripts/notify) — guarded so a missing export is a no-op, and the script itself no-ops unless ~/.miss-claude/bark.env is configured AND the mission's mission.json says notifications:true (the dashboard's 🔔 toggle). (0) SessionStart + UserPromptSubmit -> $MISSION_CONSOLE_SESSION records the transcript THIS console is writing to <mission dir>/.console-session, so the dashboard's context badge reads the right session instead of inferring one from the cwd (a console outlives the session id it started from: a /clear opens a new session file mid-process and abandons the old one). Doc-update nudges: (1) UserPromptSubmit -> $MISSION_DOC_REMINDER, time-based, nudges when LOG.md goes stale during active work. (2) Event-based 'update docs after a commit/integrate/release/deploy' is a TWO-part hook because the model refuses instructions injected via a PostToolUse additionalContext (treats them as an untrusted injection): PostToolUse(Bash) -> $MISSION_DOC_POSTACTION silently RECORDS the milestone to a marker file, and Stop -> $MISSION_DOC_STOP reads it at end-of-turn and blocks the stop with a reason (the trusted channel) so the model logs the milestone before finishing. The Stop hook is one-shot per milestone + stop_hook_active-guarded, so it can't loop.
